headline: AI Grammar Speaking Game for ESL Classes
problemStatement: Grammar practice through worksheets rarely transfers to spontaneous speech. Grammar Boss forces students to produce spoken examples on the spot — the gap where most learners struggle.
outcomes: Students produce grammatically correct sentences in real time rather than in isolated drills
Receive immediate AI feedback on grammatical accuracy and fluency — not just right or wrong
Build confidence forming complete sentences under mild time pressure
Practice a targeted grammar structure repeatedly across multiple turns with fresh content each time
howItWorks: Teacher selects a grammar target — past simple, third conditional, reported speech, and more
The AI generates a specific challenge prompt requiring a student to produce a sentence using that structure
The student speaks or types their answer on their device and submits
AI evaluates grammatical accuracy and gives structured feedback; the teacher can follow up with class discussion
teacherUseCases: Productive grammar practice immediately after explicit instruction
Diagnostic round to identify which students haven't grasped a new structure
Speaking accuracy drill that keeps the whole class engaged while one student responds

faq.a: You can type any grammar target into the session settings. The AI understands standard EFL/ESL terminology — past perfect, zero conditional, passive causative, relative clauses — and generates appropriate challenges.

faq.q: Does the AI handle spoken responses?
faq.a: In text mode, students type their sentences. The teacher can also run Grammar Boss in a spoken format where students say their answer aloud and the teacher or AI judges it.
The AI gives structured feedback: it identifies the specific grammatical error, explains the rule, and shows a corrected version. This makes each turn a micro-lesson, not just a score.

faq.q: Can I use it with beginners?
faq.a: Yes. Set easy difficulty for simpler structures — present simple, basic questions — and the prompts and expected responses scale down accordingly.

faq.q: Can students join Grammar Boss on their phones?
faq.a: Yes — any phone or laptop with a browser works. Students join via a class link or code. No app download or student account setup required.

faq.q: Can I run Grammar Boss for free?
faq.a: Yes, Grammar Boss is free to use. The teacher creates a session and students join through their browser in under a minute — no subscription needed.
